experiment: EXP1 policy offline rollout (kinematic model, command executed perfectly, needle static)
what_it_can_say: ONLY whether the goal handed to the policy / the policy's reach is accurate. It cannot represent the real arm (no tracking error, no residual servo of R4: 0.5*policy+0.75*servo is NOT in the package and is NOT simulated).

read_from_code_before_writing_this.checkpoint: r6_unified_single_goal_yaw15_seed1_final.zip sha256 6286a88c21f04abfbc4b0747a87a67bc2c5dcba17f710692c6b5138f7776e525 = the sha256 recorded in policy_offline_inputs.json and in contract.py (approach_r6). Local copy: ~/ref/daily-notes-ro/models/rl/. R4 report says whether it was user-retrained is unconfirmed; the lab's file and this file have the same hash.
read_from_code_before_writing_this.observation: dict(observation(21)=[achieved*S, desired*S, (desired-achieved)*S], achieved_goal(7), desired_goal(7)); vec7=[x_m,y_m,z_m,roll,pitch,yaw,jaw_norm] in the POLICY frame; S=[100,100,100,1,1,1,1] so positions enter in cm. No needle pose, no image: the needle only enters through the goal.
read_from_code_before_writing_this.action: 7-dim in [-1,1]; cmd_raw = measured_raw + action*STEP_SIZE_RAW; STEP_SIZE_RAW = [1mm,1mm,1mm,3deg,3deg,3deg,0.05] (contract.py approach_r6, verified there against 50 own demos 46/50 at this scale)
read_from_code_before_writing_this.goal_definition: policy goal = grasp pose backed off grasp_standoff_m = 0.007 m (lift_height) along the gripper's own -z (contract.py comment; plan.GraspLiftPlan.hover: grasp.p - grasp.R[:,2]*standoff). The trained policy never drives into the needle. R4/R6 real runs used 'grasp + 10 mm hover'; hover is a different point.
read_from_code_before_writing_this.frame: rebase bridge X = T_trained_goal * inv(T_goal_robot) (frames.FrameBridge.rebase), T_trained_goal from R6_TRAINED_GOAL_VEC7; desired_goal is therefore always the trained vector
read_from_code_before_writing_this.support: start->goal tool-frame offset box R6_START_OFFSET_TOOL_{MIN,MAX} (cm) and start->goal geodesic rotation 25.7..100.2 deg (contract.py); in_support reported for every rollout
read_from_code_before_writing_this.success_rule: contract approach_r6: ||dp|| < 1.0 cm and ||drpy|| (Euclidean norm of the RPY difference vector, SurgicAI criteria) <= 10 deg, <= 200 steps
read_from_code_before_writing_this.jaw: jaw_norm = jaw_deg/60 (45.6 deg = 0.76 = demo start, per plan_r6_start.py); demo goal jaw = 0. JawCalibration is not in the package, so this 60 deg convention is inferred from '45.6 deg is 0.76 normalised'
read_from_code_before_writing_this.not_in_package: loop.py, ros_node.py, staging.py, jaw.py (the deploy loop). The rollout below is rebuilt from obs/contract/frames/policy only.

inputs.attempts: all 14 attempts in trials_summary.csv (T3b_C uses T3_C's perception and its own start state)
inputs.start: trials/<id>/snap0/state.json cp (ECM, m + quat xyzw). Jaw: primary start value 0.76 (demo start); sensitivity 0.0 (the day's actual snap0 jaw 0.0008 rad)
inputs.grasp_point: perception.json p_star_mm (cam, mm; = human reference, s per attempt) mapped to ECM by X_cam = [p_ecm,1] @ M + c with M from calibration_summary.json and c = (3.15,-12.88,-15.70) mm (constant to 0.01 mm over the 14 pairs in the 7 preclose_pose.json files; c is DERIVED from those files, not from the calibration summary)
inputs.tool_tip: cp_goal = p_ecm - R_goal @ TCP, TCP = (-2.70, 1.08, 23.81) mm (R2-E; registration RMS 2.79 mm, so several mm possible); then back off standoff along -R_goal[:,2]
inputs.hover_reference_of_the_day: trials/<id>/trial_state.json hover.cp / hover.q (ECM). Available for 10 of 14 attempts (Q1_A, Q1_C, T1_C, T2_C, T3_C, T3b_C, T4_C, debug3_P0b_C, debug6_P0e_S, debug7_P0e_S); missing for debug1, debug2, debug4, debug5. Denominator for the hover-based tiers = 10 for GO_day; for GO_rel / GO_hold the hover reference position is still the day's, so also 10.

goal_orientation_variants.GO_day: R_goal = the day's hover orientation (hover.q): what the servo really needed for the grasp (condition C straightened wrist / A reference). PRIMARY.
goal_orientation_variants.GO_rel: trained_relative: R_goal = R_start @ rotvec(R6_START_TO_GOAL_ROTVEC_MEAN) (puts the rotation channel in distribution)
goal_orientation_variants.GO_hold: R_goal = R_start (what plan.py calls 'hold'; outside the rotation support by construction)

rollout: policy.ApproachPolicy.act deterministic; state vec7 integrated as free state (roll on SurgicAI branch via bound_roll at start); stop at the first step meeting the success rule ('policy believes done'); additionally continue to 200 steps to report where it settles. Per-step translation > 3 mm or workspace outside TRAIN_WORKSPACE_{LOW,HIGH}_M (policy frame) is recorded.
endpoint_metrics: d_goal_mm: endpoint cp - the policy's own goal cp (convergence of the policy)
d_hover_mm: endpoint cp - the day's hover.cp (the quantity the servo hand-off cares about); angle_hover_deg: geodesic of endpoint orientation vs hover.q
d_goalcp_vs_hover_mm: the policy's goal cp vs hover.cp (error of the goal construction: perception + calibration + TCP + standoff, independent of the policy)
steps, first_success_step, max_step_mm, workspace_violation, in_support (+ reasons)

servo_handoff_criteria.report: passed / n for each tier, per variant, n = number of attempts with a hover reference in that variant (printed)

robustness.seed: np.random.default_rng(20261016*100 + 10*placement_index + k), placement_index = index in the sorted list of 13 placements
robustness.start_noise: day's start position + uniform(-10,+10) mm per axis, orientation unchanged
robustness.perception_noise: grasp point: isotropic Gaussian with sigma = the placement's day snap0-snap1 p* spread (mm) from perception.json consistency (floor 0.1 mm); goal orientation: rotation of angle N(0,5 deg) about a random axis (proxy for 5 deg normal/tangent noise)
robustness.calibration: affine vs SE(3) (polar rotation of the affine's linear part, translation matching the affine at the centroid of the training cp points, plus the same c): compare endpoint difference between the two on the same draws

baseline: straight-line script to the same goal: translation <= 1 mm/step and rotation <= 3 deg/step (slerp), steps = max(ceil(dist/1mm), ceil(angle/3deg)); reports steps and whether <= 200. Under perfect execution it reaches the goal exactly, so it is a reference for steps and for how far the policy is from the goal, not an accuracy contest.
interpretation_limits: Perfect execution; the needle is static; the R4 servo residual is not modelled; the jaw convention is inferred; hover reference is the day's measured cp, whose tip position carries the TCP error; samples are tiny; no statistics beyond counts with denominators.
